REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY THURSDAY - AUGUST 9, 2018 - CITY HALL - 07:00 P.M. City Council Chamber AGENDA MATERIALS: Reports and materials related to items on this Agenda are available for public inspection at the City Clerk's Office, Cerritos City Hall, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1248. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's Office at the above address during normal business hours as noted. PUBLIC COMMENTS: For all Agenda Items, except for Consent Calendar Items, public comments will be allowed at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered. The general public comments portion of the meeting, under Agenda Item 6, will not exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five minutes, unless determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of appropriate responses, persons are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record. PUBLIC HEARINGS: Public hearings will be conducted in the order indicated on the agenda, unless otherwise directed. Please complete and submit a blue Speakers Card if you wish to present testimony. Conduct of public hearings will occur in substantially the following sequence: the item to be heard is announced, a report of written correspondence and staff report are received, and the City Council asks questions of staff. The public hearing is opened and verbal testimony will occur in the following order: the applicant, if applicable, those in favor, opposed, or interested parties, and rebuttal by applicant. Speakers are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record. After verbal testimony, the public hearing is closed and the matter is deliberated with a determination being made or a continuation of the matter. 1. Call to Order 2. Invocation The California Court of Appeal has concluded that sectarian prayer as part of the City Council meetings is not permitted under the Constitution. Invocation - Revised 3. Pledge of Allegiance Pledge of Allegiance 4. Roll Call 5. Presentations/Appointments 5A. Presentations Presentations 5B. Review and consideration of the Cerritos Regional Chamber of Commerce recommendation of a private sector representative to the Board of Directors of the Southeast Los Angeles County Workforce Development Board (SELACO WDB) (COUNCIL). Agenda Report 6. Public Comments and Suggestions This section is reserved for comments related to Consent Calendar Items and items not listed on the Agenda but within the subject matter jurisdiction of the City Council/Successor Agency. Comments are limited to 5 minutes per person. 7. Consent Calendar Items under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion. Subject to the discretion of the City Council/Successor Agency, there will be no separate discussion of these items unless a Council/Agency Member or citizen so requests, in which event the item may be removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately. 7A. Approval of Minutes Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of July 26, 2018 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY). Minutes 7B.1. Approval of the Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated August 9, 2018 (COUNCIL). City Register 7B. Approval of Register of Demands 7C. Adoption of Ordinance Ordinance introduced at the regular meeting of July 12, 2018: Waive full reading of and adopt Ordinance No. 1022, AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS AUTHORIZING AN AMENDMENT TO THE CONTRACT BETWEEN THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS AND THE BOARD OF ADMINISTRATION OF THE CALIFORNIA PUBLIC EMPLOYEES' RETIREMENT SYSTEM (COUNCIL). Agenda Report 8. Public Hearings 9. New and Old Business 9A. Review and consideration of a request for City consent to the assignment of a ground lease and approval of an estoppel certificate in connection with the assignment of the ground lease interests of two (2) Cerritos Towne Center office properties located at 12900 Park Plaza Drive and 12911 183rd Street, Cerritos, California, 90703 from SFI Cerritos, LLC, a Delaware Limited Liability Company to Cerritos Corporate Center Property Owner LLC, a Delaware Limited Liability Company, or another affiliated entity which has been approved by the City (APN 7030-011-011) (COUNCIL). Agenda Report 9B. Review and consideration of award of Bid No. 1342-18, Printing of the Cerritos Center for the Performing Arts 2018-2019 Fall and Spring Postcards (COUNCIL). Agenda Report 9C. Review and consideration of a recommendation to reject all bids for Bid No. 1343-18, Street Improvements in Residential Streets, Project No. 14088 (COUNCIL). Agenda Report 10. Legislative Items 10A. Report on pending legislation. 10B. Review and consideration to support or oppose specific legislation in the State or Federal legislature or in the State or Federal Executive Office for signature. 10B.1. Review and consideration of opposition to certain portions of the Bureau of Cannabis Control's proposed regulations for the implementation of the Medicinal and Adult-Use Cannabis Regulation and Safety Act (COUNCIL). Agenda Report 11. City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings During this part of the meeting members of the City Council report to the community on various matters of interest, including reports concerning committees on which the Councilmembers serve and reports on meetings/conferences attended. In addition, requests may be made of the staff for reports which will be presented to the City Council at a subsequent meeting, or for the scheduling of future agenda items. There will be no discussion or action taken on any of the items that may be presented during this agenda item. 12. Closed Session 12A. PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957 (COUNCIL) Title: City Manager 12B. PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957 (COUNCIL) Title: City Attorney 12C. PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957 (COUNCIL) Title: City Clerk 13. Adjournment

MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD ON
AUGUST 9, 2018, IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS AT CERRITOS CITY HALL, 18125
BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Youth Pastor Intern Jeffrey Chan, First Evangelical
  Community Church of Cerritos.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by James Dunn, Isaiah Martinez, and Justin
  Wayhdui, Recreation Services Division - Campers in Leadership Training
  participants.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in
  attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Jim Edwards
  Council/Agency Member Grace Hu
  Council/Agency Member Frank A. Yokoyama
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Naresh Solanki
  Mayor/Chair Mark E. Pulido

5.  Presentations/Appointments

5A.  Presentations - None.

5B.  Review and consideration of the Cerritos Regional Chamber of Commerce
  recommendation of a private sector representative to the Board of Directors of
  the Southeast Los Angeles County Workforce Development Board (SELACO
  WDB) (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Vida Barone, City Clerk.

  The Mayor opened public comments.

  Noting there were no individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor closed public
  comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Solanki, and seconded by Hu, to:
  1.  Confirm the Cerritos Regional Chamber of Commerce’s nomination of
  Pino Pathak for continued service on the SELACO WDB Board of Directors
  for a two-year term expiring on June 2020; and
  2.  Confirm the Cerritos Regional Chamber of Commerce’s nomination of
  Dilip M. Butani to fill the unexpired term of service on the SELACO WDB
  Board of Directors through June 30, 2019; and
  3.  Direct staff to place an item on the agenda prior to June 30, 2019 for
  review and consideration of a Cerritos’ Regional Chamber of Commerce
  nomination of a private sector representative to the SELACO WDB
  (COUNCIL).
 City of Cerritos  August 9, 2018
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 2 of 6

5.  Presentations/Appointments (continued)

5B.  (continued)

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Hu, Yokoyama, Solanki, Pulido
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

7.  Consent Calendar
  Items under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by
  one motion. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless a
  Council/Agency Member or citizen so requests, in which event the item will be
  removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.

7A.  Approval of Minutes

  Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of
  July 26, 2018 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Solanki, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the
  City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of July 26, 2018
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Hu, Yokoyama, Solanki, Pulido
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7B.  Approval of the Register of Demands

7B.1. Approval of the Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated August 9,
  2018 (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Solanki, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the
  Register of Demands as follows:

  1.  City of Cerritos  7/26/2018  $11,050,710.88 (COUNCIL)

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Hu, Yokoyama, Solanki, Pulido
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  August 9, 2018
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 3 of 6

7.  Consent Calendar (continued)

7C.  Adoption of Ordinance

  Ordinance introduced at the regular meeting of July 12, 2018:

  Waive full reading of and adopt Ordinance 1022, AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS AUTHORIZING AN AMENDMENT TO THE
  CONTRACT BETWEEN THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS AND THE
  BOARD OF ADMINISTRATION OF THE CALIFORNIA PUBLIC EMPLOYEES’
  RETIREMENT SYSTEM (COUNCIL).

  This item was removed from the Consent Calendar and placed under New and
  Old Business for separate consideration.

8.  Public Hearings

  None.

9.  New and Old Business

7C.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt Ordinance No. 1022,
  AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
  AUTHORIZING AN AMENDMENT TO THE CONTRACT BETWEEN THE CITY COUNCIL
  OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS AND THE BOARD OF ADMINISTRATION OF THE
  CALIFORNIA PUBLIC EMPLOYEES’ RETIREMENT SYSTEM.

  Ordinance was first introduced at the regular meeting of July 12, 2018:

  This item was removed from the Consent Calendar and placed under New and
  Old Business for separate consideration.

  A staff report was given by Vida Barone, City Clerk.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected
  to speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Yokoyama, and seconded by Hu, to waive full reading of
  and adopt Ordinance No. 1022, AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF
  THE CITY OF CERRITOS AUTHORIZING AN AMENDMENT TO THE CONTRACT
  BETWEEN THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS AND THE BOARD
  OF ADMINISTRATION OF THE CALIFORNIA PUBLIC EMPLOYEES’
  RETIREMENT SYSTEM (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (3 – 2) as follows:

  AYES:  Hu, Yokoyama, Pulido
  NOES:  Edwards, Solanki
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  August 9, 2018
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 4 of 6

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9A.  Review and consideration of a request for City consent to the assignment of a
  ground lease and approval of an estoppel certificate in connection with the
  assignment of the ground lease interests of two (2) Cerritos Towne Center office
  properties located at 12900 Park Plaza Drive and 12911 183rd Street, Cerritos,
  California, 90703 from SFI Cerritos, LLC, a Delaware Limited Liability Company
  to Cerritos Corporate Center Property Owner LLC, a Delaware Limited Liability
  Company, or another affiliated entity which has been approved by the City (APN
  7030-011-011) (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Kristin Aguila, Advanced Planning Manager.  A
  PowerPoint Presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who
  elected to speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Solanki, and seconded by Edwards, to authorize the
  City Manager, or his designee, to execute the document(s) to facilitate,
  acknowledge and consent to the transfer of the Ground Lessee interest in the
  Cerritos Towne Center office buildings located at 12900 Park Place Drive and
  12911 183rd Street, in such form as the City Manager shall deem appropriate,
  including any estoppel certificates, assignment consent, or related implementing
  documentation required or appropriate in connection with the completion of
  such assignment in the forms attached hereto or such other form as the City
  Manager shall deem appropriate (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Hu, Yokoyama, Solanki, Pulido
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9B.  Review and consideration of award of Bid No. 1342-18, Printing of the Cerritos
  Center for the Performing Arts 2018-2019 Fall and Spring Postcards (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Laurie Kajiwara, Pubic Information Manager.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who
  elected to speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Edwards, and seconded by Hu, to award Bid No.
  1342-18, Printing of the Cerritos Center for the Performing Arts 2018-2019 Fall
  and Spring Postcards to Advantage Mailing, Inc. in the amount of $16,722.46
  (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Hu, Yokoyama, Solanki, Pulido
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  August 9, 2018
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 5 of 6

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9C.  Review and consideration of a recommendation to reject all bids for Bid No.
  1343-18, Street Improvements in Residential Streets, Project No. 14088
  (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Dario Simoes, Assistant City Engineer. A PowerPoint
  Presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who
  elected to speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Solanki, and seconded by Yokoyama, to:

  1.  Reject all bids for Street Improvements In Residential Streets, Bid No.
  1343-18; and
  2.  Direct staff to re-advertise the project with a revised project scope in an
  attempt to achieve additional savings (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Hu, Yokoyama, Solanki, Pulido
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

10.  Legislative Items

10B.1.Review and consideration of opposition to certain portions of the Bureau of
  Cannabis Control’s proposed regulations for the implementation of the Medicinal
  and Adult-Use Cannabis Regulation and Safety Act (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Kathleen Jung Matsumoto, Assistant City Manager.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who
  elected to speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Hu, and seconded by Solanki, to direct staff to
  prepare a letter to the Bureau of Cannabis Control opposing the proposed
  regulations for the implementation of the Medicinal and Adult-Use Cannabis
  Regulation and Safety Act (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Hu, Yokoyama, Solanki, Pulido
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  August 9, 2018
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 6 of 6

11.  City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings

  Reports were provided by Councilmembers Edwards, Hu, and Yokoyama, Mayor
  Pro Tem Solanki, and Mayor Pulido.

  CONSENSUS (Edwards): Direct staff to place an item on the next agenda
  relating to the Cerritos Regional Chamber of Commerce.

12.  Closed Session

  The City Council did not recess to Closed Session to discuss any items.

12A.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957 (COUNCIL)
  Title: City Manager

12B.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957 (COUNCIL)
  Title: City Attorney

12C.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957 (COUNCIL)
  Title: City Clerk

13.  Adjournment

  The meeting was adjourned at 8:13 p.m.

ATTEST:

  /s/Vida Barone _
  Vida Barone, City Clerk/Agency Secretary

_/s/Mark E. Pulido______________
Mark E. Pulido, Mayor/Chair

APPROVED: August 23, 2018
